title: THE CAPITAL
IS NOT
THE BIG CITY
hook: Five countries where the capital is not the most famous city. Three seconds each. Can you get all five?

qs.q: What is the capital of Canada?
qs.fact: Queen Victoria picked Ottawa as the capital in 1857.
qs.sayAnswer: Ottawa! Queen Victoria picked it as the capital in 1857.

qs.q: What is the capital of Brazil?
qs.fact: Brasília was built from scratch and replaced Rio de Janeiro in 1960.
qs.sayAnswer: Brasilia! It was built from scratch, and replaced Rio de Janeiro as the capital in 1960.

qs.q: What is the capital of New Zealand?
qs.fact: Wellington is the southernmost capital of any sovereign country.
qs.sayAnswer: Wellington! It is the southernmost capital of any sovereign country in the world.

qs.q: What is the capital of Morocco?
qs.fact: Casablanca is Morocco's biggest city, but the government sits in Rabat.
qs.sayAnswer: Rabat! Casablanca is Morocco's biggest city, but the government sits in Rabat.

qs.q: What is the capital of Myanmar?
qs.fact: Myanmar moved its government from Yangon to brand-new Naypyidaw in 2005.
qs.sayAnswer: Nay-pee-daw! Myanmar moved its government there from Yangon in 2005, to a brand new city.

title: EARTH'S
BIGGEST
RECORDS
hook: Biggest, tallest, deepest, lowest. Five record breakers, three seconds each. Can you get five out of five?

qs.q: Which is the largest ocean on Earth?
qs.fact: The Pacific is bigger than all of Earth's land put together.
qs.sayAnswer: The Pacific! It is bigger than all of the land on Earth put together.

qs.q: Which is the largest country in the world by area?
qs.fact: Russia covers about 17 million square km and spans 11 time zones.
qs.sayAnswer: Russia! It covers about 17 million square kilometers, and spans 11 time zones.

qs.q: Angel Falls, the world's tallest waterfall, is in which country?
qs.fact: The water drops 979 meters, almost as high as three Eiffel Towers.
qs.sayAnswer: Venezuela! The water drops 979 meters. That is almost as high as 3 Eiffel Towers.

qs.q: The deepest point in the ocean lies in which trench?
qs.fact: Its Challenger Deep is nearly 11 km down, deeper than Everest is tall.
qs.sayAnswer: The Mariana Trench! Its Challenger Deep is nearly 11 kilometers down. That is deeper than Mount Everest is tall.

qs.q: The lowest point on dry land is on the shore of which body of water?
qs.fact: The Dead Sea's shore lies more than 400 meters below sea level.
qs.sayAnswer: The Dead Sea! Its shore lies more than 400 meters below sea level.

title: WHOSE
FLAG
IS THIS?
hook: Five flags, three seconds each. The first one is easy. The last one has a twin. Ready?

qs.q: Whose flag is this?
qs.fact: Japan calls its flag the Hinomaru, meaning the circle of the sun.
qs.sayAnswer: Japan! The Japanese call it the Hee-no-mah-roo, which means the circle of the sun.

qs.q: Whose flag is this?
qs.fact: The maple leaf flag only dates from 1965. Its leaf has 11 points.
qs.sayAnswer: Canada! The maple leaf flag only dates from 1965, and its leaf has 11 points.

qs.q: Whose flag is this?
qs.fact: Its 27 stars stand for Brazil's 26 states and the Federal District.
qs.sayAnswer: Brazil! Its 27 stars stand for the 26 states, plus the Federal District.

qs.q: Whose flag is this?
qs.fact: Nepal's is the only national flag that is not a rectangle.
qs.sayAnswer: Nepal! It is the only national flag in the world that is not a rectangle.

qs.q: Whose flag is this?
qs.fact: Ivory Coast flies the same colors in reverse: orange, white, green.
qs.sayAnswer: Ireland! Ivory Coast flies the same three colors in reverse order: orange, white, green.

title: OCEANS
AND SEAS
5 OUT OF 5?
hook: Most of our planet is covered by water. How well do you know it? Five questions, three seconds each!

qs.q: Which ocean lies between Africa and Australia?
qs.fact: The Indian Ocean is the third largest ocean, and the warmest.
qs.sayAnswer: The Indian Ocean! It is the third largest ocean, and the warmest.

qs.q: Which is the smallest ocean in the world?
qs.fact: The Arctic is also the shallowest of the world's 5 oceans.
qs.sayAnswer: The Arctic! It is also the shallowest of the world's 5 oceans.

qs.q: Which canal links the Mediterranean Sea to the Red Sea?
qs.fact: The Suez Canal opened in 1869 and runs 193 km through Egypt.
qs.sayAnswer: The Suez Canal! It opened in 1869, and runs 193 kilometers through Egypt.

qs.q: Which strait separates Europe from Africa?
qs.fact: At its narrowest, Spain and Morocco are less than 15 km apart.
qs.sayAnswer: The Strait of Gibraltar! At its narrowest point, Spain and Morocco are less than 15 kilometers apart.

qs.q: Which is the only sea on Earth without a land boundary?
qs.fact: The Sargasso Sea is bordered by four Atlantic currents, not by land.
qs.sayAnswer: The Sargasso Sea! It is bordered by four Atlantic Ocean currents, not by land.

title: HOW WELL
DO YOU KNOW
EUROPE?
hook: How well do you know Europe? Five questions, three seconds each. The last one stumps most people!

qs.q: In which country is the Colosseum?
qs.fact: Opened in AD 80, it is the largest ancient amphitheater ever built.
qs.sayAnswer: Italy! The Colosseum in Rome opened in the year 80, and it is the largest ancient amphitheater ever built.

qs.q: Which is the longest river in Europe?
qs.fact: The Volga runs about 3,500 km across Russia to the Caspian Sea.
qs.sayAnswer: The Volga! It runs about 3,500 kilometers across Russia, to the Caspian Sea.

qs.q: Which European Union country has the most people?
qs.fact: Germany has about 84 million people. France is next, with about 68 million.
qs.sayAnswer: Germany! It has about 84 million people. France is next, with about 68 million.

qs.q: Which river flows through four national capitals?
qs.fact: Vienna, Bratislava, Budapest and Belgrade all sit on the Danube.
qs.sayAnswer: The Danube! Vienna, Bratislava, Budapest and Belgrade all sit on its banks.

qs.q: Which European country is doubly landlocked?
qs.fact: Its only neighbors, Switzerland and Austria, are landlocked too.
qs.sayAnswer: Lick-ten-stine! Its only neighbors, Switzerland and Austria, are landlocked too. Only Uzbekistan shares that fate.

title: HOW WELL
DO YOU KNOW
ASIA?
hook: How well do you know Asia, the biggest continent on Earth? Five questions, three seconds each!

qs.q: In which country is the Taj Mahal?
qs.fact: Emperor Shah Jahan built it as a tomb for his wife, Mumtaz Mahal.
qs.sayAnswer: India! Emperor Shah Jahan built it as a tomb for his wife, Mumtaz Mahal.

qs.q: What is the highest mountain in Japan?
qs.fact: Mount Fuji is 3,776 meters high and last erupted in 1707.
qs.sayAnswer: Mount Fuji! It is 3,776 meters high, and it last erupted in 1707.

qs.q: Which city was called Edo until 1868?
qs.fact: The new name, Tokyo, simply means Eastern Capital.
qs.sayAnswer: Tokyo! The new name simply means Eastern Capital.

qs.q: The Gobi Desert stretches across which two countries?
qs.fact: The Gobi is a cold desert. Frost and even snow can cover its dunes.
qs.sayAnswer: China and Mongolia! The Gobi is a cold desert. Frost and even snow can cover its dunes.

qs.q: Which is the only landlocked country in Southeast Asia?
qs.fact: Laos is boxed in by China, Vietnam, Cambodia, Thailand and Myanmar.
qs.sayAnswer: Laos! It is boxed in by China, Vietnam, Cambodia, Thailand and Myanmar.

title: HOW WELL
DO YOU KNOW
AFRICA?
hook: How well do you know Africa? Five questions, three seconds each. Number five surprises almost everyone!

qs.q: What is the highest mountain in Africa?
qs.fact: Kilimanjaro, in Tanzania, rises 5,895 meters and stands all alone.
qs.sayAnswer: Kilimanjaro! It rises 5,895 meters in Tanzania, and it stands all alone, not in a mountain range.

qs.q: Which African country has the most people?
qs.fact: Nigeria is home to well over 200 million people.
qs.sayAnswer: Nigeria! It is home to well over 200 million people.

qs.q: Which is the largest country in Africa by area?
qs.fact: Algeria took the title in 2011, when Sudan split into two countries.
qs.sayAnswer: Algeria! It took the title in 2011, when Sudan split into two countries.

qs.q: Victoria Falls is on which river?
qs.fact: The falls are 1.7 km wide, on the border of Zambia and Zimbabwe.
qs.sayAnswer: The Zambezi! The falls are 1.7 kilometers wide, on the border of Zambia and Zimbabwe.

qs.q: Which country has more ancient pyramids than Egypt?
qs.fact: Sudan has more than 200 pyramids. Egypt has between 120 and 140.
qs.sayAnswer: Sudan! It has more than 200 ancient pyramids. Egypt has between 120 and 140.

title: HOW WELL
DO YOU KNOW
THE AMERICAS?
hook: From Alaska to Patagonia: how well do you know the Americas? Five questions, three seconds each!

qs.q: In which country is Machu Picchu?
qs.say: In which country is Mah-choo Peek-choo?
qs.fact: The Inca built it in the 1400s, about 2,430 meters up in the Andes.
qs.sayAnswer: Peru! The Inca built Mah-choo Peek-choo in the 1400s, about 2,430 meters up in the Andes.

qs.q: Which is the largest country in South America?
qs.fact: Brazil covers nearly half of the whole continent.
qs.sayAnswer: Brazil! It covers nearly half of the whole continent.

qs.q: What is the highest mountain in the Americas?
qs.fact: Aconcagua, in Argentina, is the highest peak anywhere outside Asia.
qs.sayAnswer: Ah-con-cah-gwa! This giant in Argentina is the highest peak anywhere outside Asia.

qs.q: Which South American country has English as its official language?
qs.fact: Guyana was a British colony until 1966. Belize is in Central America.
qs.sayAnswer: Guy-anna! It was a British colony until 1966. And Belize is in Central America.

qs.q: Which of these countries does NOT border Brazil?
qs.fact: Brazil touches every South American country except Chile and Ecuador.
qs.sayAnswer: Chile! Brazil touches every country in South America, except Chile and Ecuador.

title: HOW WELL
DO YOU KNOW
THE 50 STATES?
hook: Fifty states, five questions, three seconds each. The last one trips up plenty of Americans!

qs.q: Which state is home to the Grand Canyon?
qs.fact: The canyon is 277 miles long and more than a mile deep.
qs.sayAnswer: Arizona! The canyon is 277 miles long, and more than a mile deep.

qs.q: Which is the smallest US state by area?
qs.say: Which is the smallest U.S. state by area?
qs.fact: Rhode Island would fit inside Alaska more than 400 times.
qs.sayAnswer: Rhode Island! It would fit inside Alaska more than 400 times.

qs.q: What is the capital of California?
qs.fact: Sacramento was chosen as California's capital back in 1854.
qs.sayAnswer: Sacramento! It was chosen as California's capital back in 1854.

qs.q: Which US state has the longest coastline?
qs.say: Which U.S. state has the longest coastline?
qs.fact: Alaska has about 6,640 miles of coast. Florida is second with 1,350.
qs.sayAnswer: Alaska! It has about 6,640 miles of coast. Florida is second, with 1,350.

qs.q: Which is the only state that borders exactly one other state?
qs.fact: Maine touches only New Hampshire. Its other neighbor is Canada.
qs.sayAnswer: Maine! It touches only New Hampshire. Its other neighbor is Canada.

title: USA
GEOGRAPHY
5 OUT OF 5?
hook: Think you know the United States? Five questions, three seconds each, and the last one is tiny!

qs.q: Which US state is this?
qs.fact: Florida has the longest coastline of the lower 48 states.
qs.sayAnswer: Florida! It has the longest coastline of the lower 48 states.

qs.q: Which is the southernmost US state?
qs.say: Which is the southernmost U.S. state?
qs.fact: Ka Lae, on Hawaii's Big Island, is the southernmost point of all 50 states.
qs.sayAnswer: Hawaii! The southern tip of its Big Island is the southernmost point of all 50 states.

qs.q: The lowest point in North America is in which state?
qs.fact: Badwater Basin in Death Valley lies about 85 meters below sea level.
qs.sayAnswer: California! Badwater Basin, in Death Valley, lies about 280 feet below sea level.

qs.q: Which state is NOT part of the Four Corners?
qs.fact: Arizona, Colorado, New Mexico and Utah all meet at a single point.
qs.sayAnswer: Nevada! Arizona, Colorado, New Mexico and Utah all meet at a single point.

qs.q: Which is the least populous US state capital?
qs.say: Which is the least populous U.S. state capital?
qs.fact: Montpelier, Vermont, has about 8,000 people and no McDonald's.
qs.sayAnswer: Mont-peel-yer! The capital of Vermont has only about 8,000 people, and no McDonald's.

title: ISLAND
QUIZ
5 OUT OF 5?
hook: Five questions about the world's islands. Three seconds each. Can you make it to the end?

qs.q: Which is the largest island in the world?
qs.fact: About 80% of Greenland lies under a giant sheet of ice.
qs.sayAnswer: Greenland! About 80 percent of it lies under a giant sheet of ice.

qs.q: The island of Bali belongs to which country?
qs.fact: Bali is the only Hindu-majority province in Indonesia.
qs.sayAnswer: Indonesia! Bali is the only province in Indonesia with a Hindu majority.

qs.q: Which is the largest island in the Mediterranean Sea?
qs.fact: Sicily is also home to Etna, Europe's tallest active volcano.
qs.sayAnswer: Sicily! It is also home to Mount Etna, the tallest active volcano in Europe.

qs.q: Madagascar lies in which ocean?
qs.fact: About 90% of Madagascar's wildlife lives nowhere else on Earth.
qs.sayAnswer: The Indian Ocean! About 90 percent of Madagascar's wildlife lives nowhere else on Earth.

qs.q: Which island is shared by three countries?
qs.fact: Indonesia, Malaysia and Brunei share Borneo, the 3rd largest island.
qs.sayAnswer: Borneo! Indonesia, Malaysia and Brunei share it. It is the 3rd largest island in the world.

title: MOUNTAIN
QUIZ
5 OUT OF 5?
hook: Five questions about the world's mountains. They get steeper as you go. Can you reach the summit?

qs.q: Mount Everest is part of which mountain range?
qs.fact: Everest stands 8,849 meters high, on the border of Nepal and China.
qs.sayAnswer: The Himalayas! Everest stands 8,849 meters high, on the border of Nepal and China.

qs.q: Which is the longest mountain range on land?
qs.fact: The Andes run the whole length of South America, through 7 countries.
qs.sayAnswer: The Andes! They run the whole length of South America, through 7 countries.

qs.q: Which mountain range traditionally divides Europe from Asia?
qs.fact: The Urals stretch about 2,500 km from north to south across Russia.
qs.sayAnswer: The Urals! They stretch about 2,500 kilometers from north to south across Russia.

qs.q: What is the second-highest mountain on Earth?
qs.fact: K2 is 8,611 meters high. It was the 2nd peak surveyed in the Karakoram.
qs.sayAnswer: K2! It is 8,611 meters high. The name means it was the 2nd peak surveyed in the Karakoram range.

qs.q: Measured from base to summit, which is the tallest mountain on Earth?
qs.fact: Mauna Kea in Hawaii rises about 10,200 meters from the ocean floor.
qs.sayAnswer: Mow-na Kay-ah! This Hawaiian volcano rises about 10,200 meters from the ocean floor. Most of it is under water.

title: RIVERS
AND LAKES
5 OUT OF 5?
hook: Rivers and lakes! Five questions, three seconds each. Only real map lovers get the last one.

qs.q: Which river flows through Cairo?
qs.fact: The Nile flows north, and its basin touches 11 countries.
qs.sayAnswer: The Nile! It flows north, and its basin touches 11 countries.

qs.q: Which river carries the most water in the world?
qs.fact: The Amazon carries about a fifth of all river water reaching the sea.
qs.sayAnswer: The Amazon! It carries about a fifth of all the river water that reaches the sea.

qs.q: Which is the deepest lake in the world?
qs.fact: Baikal, in Siberia, is over 1,600 meters deep. It is also the oldest lake.
qs.sayAnswer: Lake By-kal! This Siberian lake is over 1,600 meters deep. It is also the oldest lake on Earth.

qs.q: Lake Titicaca lies on the border of which two countries?
qs.fact: It sits about 3,800 meters up in the Andes, and big ships still sail it.
qs.sayAnswer: Peru and Bolivia! The lake sits about 3,800 meters up in the Andes, and big ships still sail it.

qs.q: Which major river crosses the equator twice?
qs.fact: The Congo is also the deepest river known, about 220 meters in places.
qs.sayAnswer: The Congo! It is also the deepest river known, about 220 meters in places.

title: NAME
THE CITY
5 OUT OF 5?
hook: Can you name the city? Five questions, three seconds each. Careful with the last one!

qs.q: Which city is home to the Christ the Redeemer statue?
qs.fact: The statue is 30 meters tall and has watched over Rio since 1931.
qs.sayAnswer: Rio de Janeiro! The statue is 30 meters tall, and has watched over the city since 1931.

qs.q: Which city has the world's tallest building, the Burj Khalifa?
qs.say: Which city has the world's tallest building, the Burj Khalifa?
qs.fact: The Burj Khalifa is 828 meters tall and opened in 2010.
qs.sayAnswer: Dubai! The Burj Khalifa is 828 meters tall, and opened in 2010.

qs.q: Which Italian city is built on more than 100 small islands?
qs.fact: Venice has canals instead of streets, and around 400 bridges.
qs.sayAnswer: Venice! It has canals instead of streets, and around 400 bridges.

qs.q: Which city was once called Constantinople?
qs.fact: Before that it was Byzantium. The world switched to Istanbul in 1930.
qs.sayAnswer: Istanbul! Before that, it was called Byzantium. The world switched to the name Istanbul in 1930.

qs.q: Which is the northernmost capital of a sovereign country?
qs.fact: Reykjavik, Iceland, sits at 64 degrees north, near the Arctic Circle.
qs.sayAnswer: Rake-ya-vik! The capital of Iceland sits at 64 degrees north, near the Arctic Circle.

title: 5 TRICK
QUESTIONS
DON'T BLINK
hook: These five geography questions sound easy. They are not. Trust the map, not your gut!

qs.q: Which of these cities is farthest north?
qs.fact: Rome sits at almost 42 degrees north, above New York, Madrid and Beijing.
qs.sayAnswer: Rome! It sits at almost 42 degrees north, above New York, Madrid and Beijing.

qs.q: Which country has the longest coastline in the world?
qs.fact: Canada has over 200,000 km of coast, counting its thousands of islands.
qs.sayAnswer: Canada! It has over 200,000 kilometers of coast, counting its thousands of islands.

qs.q: Which of these US cities is farthest west?
qs.say: Which of these U.S. cities is farthest west?
qs.fact: Reno, Nevada, is farther west than Los Angeles, on the Pacific coast.
qs.sayAnswer: Reno! This Nevada city is farther west than Los Angeles, which sits on the Pacific coast.

qs.q: At their closest, how far apart are Russia and the United States?
qs.fact: Russia's Big Diomede and Alaska's Little Diomede are about 4 km apart.
qs.sayAnswer: About 4 kilometers! That is the gap between Russia's Big Diomede island, and Alaska's Little Diomede.

qs.q: With which country does France share its longest land border?
qs.fact: French Guiana, part of France, shares a 730 km border with Brazil.
qs.sayAnswer: Brazil! French Guiana in South America is part of France, and shares a 730 kilometer border with Brazil.

title: WHO IS
THE
NEIGHBOR?
hook: Borders and neighbors! Five questions, three seconds each. The map gets tricky at the end.

qs.q: Which is the only country that borders Portugal?
qs.fact: Their border was set in 1297 and is among the oldest in the world.
qs.sayAnswer: Spain! Their border was set in 1297, and is among the oldest in the world.

qs.q: Which two countries share the world's longest border?
qs.fact: It runs 8,891 km, including the long border between Canada and Alaska.
qs.sayAnswer: Canada and the U.S.A! Their border runs 8,891 kilometers, including the long stretch between Canada and Alaska.

qs.q: Which tiny country lies between France and Spain?
qs.fact: Andorra's two princes are a Spanish bishop and the president of France.
qs.sayAnswer: Andorra! Its two princes are a Spanish bishop, and the president of France.

qs.q: Which country is completely surrounded by South Africa?
qs.fact: All of Lesotho lies above 1,400 meters, higher than any other country.
qs.sayAnswer: Leh-soo-too! All of it lies above 1,400 meters. No other country has such a high lowest point.

qs.q: Which country is surrounded by Senegal on three sides?
qs.fact: The Gambia, mainland Africa's smallest country, is under 50 km wide.
qs.sayAnswer: The Gambia! It is the smallest country on the African mainland, and it is under 50 kilometers wide.

title: CONTINENTS
QUIZ
5 OUT OF 5?
hook: Everybody knows the continents. Or do they? Five questions, three seconds each. Go!

qs.q: Which is the largest continent?
qs.fact: Asia holds about 30% of Earth's land and about 60% of its people.
qs.sayAnswer: Asia! It holds about 30 percent of Earth's land, and about 60 percent of its people.

qs.q: Which is the smallest continent?
qs.fact: Australia covers about 7.6 million square km. Asia is almost 6 times bigger.
qs.sayAnswer: Australia! It covers about 7.6 million square kilometers. Asia is almost 6 times bigger.

qs.q: On which continent is the Atacama, the driest non-polar desert?
qs.fact: The Atacama runs along the Pacific coast of northern Chile.
qs.sayAnswer: South America! The Atacama runs along the Pacific coast of northern Chile.

qs.q: Which continent is crossed by both the equator and the prime meridian?
qs.fact: The two lines meet in the Atlantic, just off Africa's west coast.
qs.sayAnswer: Africa! The two lines meet in the Atlantic Ocean, just off Africa's west coast.

qs.q: Which continent holds most of Earth's fresh water?
qs.fact: Antarctica's ice sheet locks up well over half of Earth's fresh water.
qs.sayAnswer: Antarctica! Its ice sheet locks up well over half of all the fresh water on Earth.

title: WHICH
COUNTRY
IS IT IN?
hook: Famous landmarks, but which country are they in? Five questions, three seconds each!

qs.q: In which country is the Sagrada Família?
qs.say: In which country is the Sagrada Familia church?
qs.fact: Work on the Barcelona church began in 1882 and it is still not finished.
qs.sayAnswer: Spain! Work on this church in Barcelona began in 1882, and it is still not finished.

qs.q: In which country are the Maya ruins of Chichén Itzá?
qs.say: In which country are the Maya ruins of Chee-chen Eet-sah?
qs.fact: Its famous step pyramid, El Castillo, is about 30 meters high.
qs.sayAnswer: Mexico! The famous step pyramid there, El Castillo, is about 30 meters high.

qs.q: In which country is the rock-carved city of Petra?
qs.fact: Petra is called the Rose City, after the sandstone it is carved from.
qs.sayAnswer: Jordan! Petra is called the Rose City, after the color of the sandstone it is carved from.

qs.q: In which country is the temple of Angkor Wat?
qs.fact: Angkor Wat is the world's largest religious structure.
qs.sayAnswer: Cambodia! Angkor Wat is the largest religious structure in the world, and it even appears on Cambodia's flag.

qs.q: Easter Island and its giant stone heads belong to which country?
qs.fact: The island has nearly 900 statues and lies about 3,500 km off Chile.
qs.sayAnswer: Chile! The island has nearly 900 statues, and lies about 3,500 kilometers off the coast of Chile.

title: CAPITALS
LEVEL:
HARD
hook: You know these countries. But do you know their capitals? Five questions, and they keep getting harder!

qs.q: What is the capital of India?
qs.fact: New Delhi was inaugurated as the capital in 1931.
qs.sayAnswer: New Delhi! It was inaugurated as the capital in 1931.

qs.q: What is the capital of Vietnam?
qs.fact: Ho Chi Minh City is bigger, but Hanoi in the north is the capital.
qs.sayAnswer: Hanoi! Ho Chi Minh City is bigger, but Hanoi in the north is the capital.

qs.q: What is the capital of Pakistan?
qs.fact: Islamabad was built in the 1960s to replace Karachi as the capital.
qs.sayAnswer: Islamabad! It was built in the 1960s to replace Karachi as the capital.

qs.q: What is the capital of Nigeria?
qs.fact: Abuja, a planned city, took over from Lagos in 1991.
qs.sayAnswer: Ah-boo-ja! This planned city took over from Lagos in 1991.

qs.q: What is the capital of Kazakhstan?
qs.fact: Astana was renamed Nur-Sultan in 2019, then changed back in 2022.
qs.sayAnswer: Astana! It was renamed Noor Sultan in 2019, then changed back to Astana in 2022.
